Timer_Reset can preempt between the read and write of the increment, so the reset is lost.

Timer_Reset can zero timerCount between the increment and the check at 97.

Timer_Reset can zero timerCount between the write at 109 and the check at 111.
Timer_Reset (priority 5) can preempt Timer_C and zero timerCount before the check at 125.
Timer_C (priority 4) can preempt Timer_Force's increment, and its write is lost.
Timer_Reset can preempt Timer_Force's increment, and the reset is lost.
